{{Quote|Not bad, not bad. A Nubian, eh?|[[Watto/Legends|Watto]] on the [[J-type 327 Nubian royal starship/Legends|J-type 327 Nubian royal starship]]|<ref name="Episode 1">{{Film|I}}</ref>}}
'''Nubia Star Drives, Incorporated''', originally called the '''Nubian Design Collective''', was a loose grouping of designers and engineers who colonized the planet [[Nubia/Legends|Nubia]] roughly 300 years before the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]]. The collective comprised a number of spacefaring species including [[Bith/Legends|Bith]], [[Human/Legends|Humans]], [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustans]], and [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] that accepted small contracts for wealthy clients.

==Influence==
[[File:NabooRoyalStarship-EpIVD.png|thumb|left|180px|The J-type 327 designed for the Naboo monarch]]
Nubian technology was used all throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] and was readily available on most [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] worlds. They were known for producing unique and beautiful designs of [[Sublight engine/Legends|Sublight drives]] and spaceframes. Their unique designs were best seen on [[J-type 327 Nubian royal starship/Legends|J-type spacecraft]]. When the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] rose to power, the collective went underground to keep experimental designs away from Imperial hands.

==History==
Shortly after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], the collective resurfaced with a completely new catalog. The company was renamed Nubia Star Drives, Inc. and began to release their unique line of products to the public.

In addition, Nubian components were used in the construction of most products of the [[Theed Palace Space Vessel Engineering Corps/Legends|Theed Palace Space Vessel Engineering Corps]].
